Introduced, warm-season, short-lived perennial herb, with a mostly adventitious root system; sparsely pilose or almost hairless. Leaves are stalked and form a basal rosette; lamina are ovate to ellipt

Greater Plantain (Plantago major) forms as as a flat rosette. It is often found on severly compacted soils and it will tolerate close mowing. It is often found in turf, roadside verges and wasteground
